_comment: The two keys that matter here are rewrites[].source and the absence of any build step.
beforeFiles, NOT rewrites: in Vercel a top-level `rewrites` entry is evaluated AFTER filesystem
routes, so /task.html would be served straight from the deployment and the paywall would never
run — a working site, an open one. `beforeFiles` is evaluated first, which is the only ordering
consistent with the invariant this project is built on (protected bytes never reach a browser
without a key). /api/* and /_vercel/* stay excluded so the function's own endpoints and Vercel's
No buildCommand and no framework: the repo root is the site. There is deliberately no `public`
outputDirectory either — Vercel's zero-config static deploy is exactly what produces a
gate-free copy of everything under /js and /data.
